product.name: Saturdaze Design System
product.description: The standalone visual language, component API, and product-pattern reference for Saturdaze.

categories.label: Actions
categories.description: Buttons, icon actions, and compact labels.

categories.label: Surfaces
categories.description: Content containers, identity, lists, and empty states.

categories.label: Planning
categories.description: Weekend, weather, and itinerary building blocks.

categories.label: Discovery
categories.description: Activities, restaurants, events, saved ideas, and voting.

components.name: Button
components.description: Primary, secondary, ghost, and destructive actions with optional leading and trailing content.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Prevents activation and exposes the native disabled state.

events.name: click
events.description: Native click from the internal button.

examples.title: Primary action
examples.description: One clear next step.
examples.markup: <sd-button><sd-icon slot="leading" name="sparkle" size="16"></sd-icon>Plan this weekend</sd-button>

examples.title: Destructive action
examples.description: Reserved for consequences that need explicit emphasis.
examples.markup: <sd-button variant="danger">Delete plan</sd-button>

components.name: Icon button
components.description: Compact icon-only action with a required accessible label.

events.name: click
events.description: Native click from the internal button.

examples.title: Save action
examples.description: Use a filled state after selection.
examples.markup: <sd-icon-button icon="heart" label="Save idea"></sd-icon-button>

components.name: Chip
components.description: Compact metadata and status label.

examples.title: Category
examples.description: Short, scannable metadata.
examples.markup: <sd-chip tone="leaf"><sd-icon name="tree" size="12"></sd-icon> Outdoors</sd-chip>

components.name: Text input
components.description: Labelled single-value input with hint support.

events.name: input
events.description: Native input event inside the open shadow root.

examples.title: Profile field
examples.description: Labels remain visible when content is entered.
examples.markup: <sd-text-input label="Family name" placeholder="The Browns" hint="Shown only to your family."></sd-text-input>

components.name: Toggle
components.description: Binary preference control.

events.name: change
events.description: Bubbles with detail.checked after keyboard or pointer activation.

examples.title: Preference
examples.description: State and label are shown together.
examples.markup: <sd-toggle label="Weather-aware suggestions" checked></sd-toggle>

components.name: Icon
components.description: Dependency-free line icon from the Saturdaze symbol set.

attributes.name: filled
attributes.description: Uses solid SVG shapes where available.

examples.title: Weather symbol
examples.description: Icons inherit the current text color.
examples.markup: <sd-icon name="sun" size="32"></sd-icon>

components.name: Avatar
components.description: Initials-based family identity marker.

examples.title: Family member
examples.description: Initials are derived from the name.
examples.markup: <sd-avatar name="Quinn Brown" tone="primary" size="lg"></sd-avatar>

components.name: Card
components.description: General-purpose content surface.

attributes.name: interactive
attributes.description: Adds hover affordance and pointer cursor.

examples.title: Information surface
examples.description: Group related information without over-emphasis.
examples.markup:
Saturday looks sunny

Two outdoor ideas are ready.

components.name: Section
components.description: Titled content region with an optional action.

examples.title: Day section
examples.description: A heading, context, and local action.
examples.markup: <sd-section title="Saturday" subtitle="Three stops · 52 minutes driving"><sd-button slot="action" size="sm" variant="ghost">View map</sd-button><sd-card variant="sunk">Your morning plan</sd-card></sd-section>

components.name: Tag group
components.description: Wrapping row for related chips.

examples.title: Active filters
examples.description: Related tags wrap as a unit.
examples.markup: <sd-tag-group><sd-chip tone="leaf">Family</sd-chip><sd-chip tone="sky">Under 20 min</sd-chip><sd-chip tone="sun">Saturday</sd-chip></sd-tag-group>

components.name: List item
components.description: Structured row with optional leading, body, and trailing content.

examples.title: Errand row
examples.description: Pairs identity with concise supporting detail.
examples.markup: <sd-list-item title="Groceries" subtitle="3 items · Saturday morning"><sd-icon slot="leading" name="bag"></sd-icon><sd-icon slot="trailing" name="chevron_right" size="16"></sd-icon></sd-list-item>

components.name: Empty state
components.description: Helpful no-content message with a next step slot.

examples.title: No saved ideas
examples.description: Explain how the collection becomes useful.
examples.markup: <sd-empty title="Nothing saved yet" subtitle="Tap the heart on an idea to keep it here." icon="heart"><sd-button size="sm">Discover ideas</sd-button></sd-empty>

components.name: Top bar
components.description: Compact page heading with leading and trailing actions.

slots.name: leading
slots.description: Leading action when back is absent.

examples.title: Detail page
examples.description: Use back navigation for nested destinations.
examples.markup: <sd-top-bar title="Saturday itinerary" back><sd-icon-button slot="trailing" icon="more" label="More options" variant="ghost"></sd-icon-button></sd-top-bar>

components.name: App navigation
components.description: Primary mobile bottom navigation that becomes a desktop rail.

attributes.name: static
attributes.description: Embeds the navigation in documentation and compositions.

examples.title: Primary destinations
examples.description: Keep destination order stable.
examples.markup: <sd-bottom-nav static active="activities"></sd-bottom-nav>

components.name: Split view
components.description: Responsive master-detail composition.

attributes.name: sticky-detail
attributes.description: Keeps detail content visible on wide screens.

attributes.name: sticky-master
attributes.description: Keeps master content visible on wide screens.

examples.title: Planner split
examples.description: Stacks at narrow widths and separates at desktop widths.
examples.markup: <sd-split-view sticky-detail><sd-card slot="master">Weekend options</sd-card><sd-card slot="detail" variant="sunk">Selected itinerary</sd-card></sd-split-view>

components.name: Authentication shell
components.description: Centered brand frame for account journeys.

slots.name: foot
slots.description: Secondary account link or legal copy.

examples.title: Sign in frame
examples.description: Keeps identity and account task focused.
examples.markup:
Welcome back

Sign in to plan your weekend.

ContinueNew here? Create an account

components.name: Authentication card
components.description: Focused surface for one account task.

examples.title: Account task
examples.description: Use one primary action per card.
examples.markup:
Check your email

We sent a secure link to quinn@example.com.

Open email app

components.name: Weekend hero
components.description: Personalized weekend entry point with primary planning action.

attributes.name: subtitle
attributes.default: Your weekend's looking good. Want me to map it out?

examples.title: Weekend prompt
examples.description: Lead with a personal, useful next step.
examples.markup: <sd-hero greeting="Morning, the Browns" subtitle="Sunny on Saturday. Want me to map it out?" cta="Plan this weekend"></sd-hero>

components.name: Weather strip
components.description: Two-day container for weekend weather.

examples.title: Weekend forecast
examples.description: Show only decision-relevant weather.
examples.markup: <sd-weather-strip><sd-weather-day day="Sat" icon="sun" hi="22" lo="14" note="Light breeze"></sd-weather-day><sd-weather-day day="Sun" icon="cloud" hi="18" lo="12" note="Cloudy"></sd-weather-day></sd-weather-strip>

components.name: Weather day
components.description: Compact forecast for one weekend day.

examples.title: Rainy day
examples.description: Pair data with a plain-language condition.
examples.markup: <sd-weather-day day="Sun" icon="rain" hi="17" lo="11" note="Rain after 3pm"></sd-weather-day>

components.name: Day card
components.description: Weekend-day summary linking into an itinerary.

examples.title: Planned day
examples.description: Summarize weather and the memorable anchor.
examples.markup: <sd-day-card day="Saturday" date="May 17" weather="22° · sunny" highlight="Lavender farm and lunch" icon="sun" href="#"><sd-chip slot="chips" tone="leaf">3 stops</sd-chip></sd-day-card>

components.name: Timeline block
components.description: Timed itinerary item with tone, lock, travel, and action states.

examples.title: Itinerary activity
examples.description: Time, place, travel, and lock state remain scannable.
examples.markup: <sd-timeline-block time="10:00" duration="90 min" title="Terre Bleu Lavender Farm" subtitle="Milton" icon="tree" tone="activity" drive="35 min"><sd-chip slot="chips" tone="leaf">Outdoors</sd-chip></sd-timeline-block>

components.name: Anticipatory callout
components.description: Proactive, contextual help that catches a likely need.

examples.title: Weather anticipation
examples.description: Offer help before weather changes the plan.
examples.markup: <sd-anticipate icon="rain" headline="Rain starts around 3pm" body="I can move the trail walk before lunch." cta="Adjust Saturday"></sd-anticipate>

components.name: Activity card
components.description: Context-rich activity recommendation.

examples.title: Personal recommendation
examples.description: Explain why the idea fits this family now.
examples.markup: <sd-activity-card title="Riverwood Conservancy" subtitle="Forest trails and owl barn" drive="8 min" why="Dry trails, close to home, and new for Eli." icon="tree" tone="outdoor" ages="4–12" tag="Great today"></sd-activity-card>

components.name: Restaurant card
components.description: Restaurant option with travel context and family votes.

examples.title: Lunch option
examples.description: Pair the restaurant with its itinerary context.
examples.markup: <sd-restaurant-card name="La Marina" style="Mediterranean · $$" near="Near Terre Bleu" drive="6 min" wifeapproved><sd-vote-row slot="votes" name="Quinn" tone="primary" vote="up"></sd-vote-row></sd-restaurant-card>

components.name: Event card
components.description: Local event summary with date, venue, and travel context.

examples.title: Local event
examples.description: Date and venue lead; distance supports the decision.
examples.markup: <sd-event-card title="Port Credit Buskerfest" venue="Memorial Park" when="11am–5pm" drive="9 min" date-day="17" date-mon="MAY" tag="Free" icon="ticket"></sd-event-card>

components.name: Saved weekend card
components.description: Stored weekend memory with rating and highlights.

attributes.name: rating
attributes.description: Family rating from zero to five.

examples.title: Weekend memory
examples.description: Keep the date, emotional label, and memorable stops together.
examples.markup: <sd-saved-card date="May 17–18" title="Lavender and lake weekend" rating="5" highlights="Terre Bleu · Port Credit · family brunch" favourite><sd-button size="sm" variant="secondary">Remix it</sd-button></sd-saved-card>

components.name: Vote row
components.description: One family member's preference control.

events.name: click
events.description: Vote buttons are handled by the consuming application.

examples.title: Positive vote
examples.description: The selected response remains visible.
examples.markup: <sd-vote-row name="Eli" tone="sky" vote="up"></sd-vote-row>

components.name: Dialog
components.description: Modal or inline-static surface for focused decisions and forms.

attributes.name: static
attributes.description: Renders the sheet in normal flow for documentation.

events.name: sd-close
events.description: Cancelable close request with an escape, backdrop, or programmatic reason.

examples.title: Confirmation
examples.description: State the consequence and offer a safe way out.
examples.markup: <sd-dialog open static title="Regenerate the weekend?" subtitle="Locked blocks stay put. Everything else gets a fresh draft."><sd-card variant="sunk"><sd-icon name="lock" size="16"></sd-icon> Commitments stay exactly where they are.</sd-card><sd-button slot="actions" variant="secondary">Cancel</sd-button><sd-button slot="actions">Regenerate</sd-button></sd-dialog>

dialogs.name: Product actions
dialogs.description: Contextual actions launched from weekend and discovery experiences.

dialogs.name: Reject submission
dialogs.description: Reject an event with an optional reason.

patterns.name: Weekend overview
patterns.description: Planning entry point and generated-weekend states.

patterns.name: Profile & errands
patterns.description: Family preferences, commitments, and practical stops.

patterns.name: Saved ideas
patterns.description: Saved weekend memories and reusable plans.
